build_phase: Phase 1 — asset audit and editorial chronology
chronology_notice: Preliminary chronology uses an editorial activity/contribution event for placement, not birth year. Date labels may be lifespans, reign periods, or dates of activity. 20 people are connected to initial research references; individual dates and identities must still be source-checked before writing the interactive biographies. Undated traditional subjects should not be assigned unsupported historical dates.
authors_policy: Give substantive priority to published scholarship by African, African American, and diasporic historians and relevant primary sources. Distinguish evidence, scholarly interpretation, and inherited tradition. Include figure-specific references in Phase 5.
